AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing 3.0 Flight Operations 3.1 Aviation W.

2. When learning Aviation Weather 3.2 Aviation Communication 3.3 Aerodynamics of Flight 4.0 Airpo, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Weather 3.2 Aviation Communication 3.3 Aerodynamics of Flight 4.0 Airpo.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Weather 3.2 Aviation Communication 3.3 Aerodynamics of Flight 4.0 Airpo.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Weather 3.2 Aviation Communication 3.3 Aerodynamics of Flight 4.0 Airpo.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Weather 3.2 Aviation Communication 3.3 Aerodynamics of Flight 4.0 Airpo.

3. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

5. When learning Aircraft Components, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Components.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Components.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Components.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Components.

6. When learning Safety in the Aviation Workplace, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the Aviation Workplace.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the Aviation Workplace.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety in the Aviation Workplace.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety in the Aviation Workplace.

7. When learning Aircraft Tools and Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Tools and Materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Tools and Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Tools and Materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Tools and Materials.

8. When learning Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

11. When learning Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construct, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construct.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construct.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construct.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construct.

12. When learning Introduction to Aviation 1.2 Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Aviation 1.2 Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Aviation 1.2 Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Aviation 1.2 Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Aviation 1.2 Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Aviation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construct and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in the Aviation Workplace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construction 2.1 Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
